column1: # recipes/flag-tables.tsv: the layouts of the tables in BOF3.exe that hold story-flag numbers.
# Layout only: no value from the exe or any game data is written here.
# Read by tools/flag_tables.py, which reads the values from the player's own BOF3.exe.
# Compiled 2026-11-09 from our reimplemented source and symbols.toml; evidence in docs/story-flags/flag-tables.md.
# One line per flag field. kind: flag (a flag number), bits (a bit image copied over a bank),
#   cond (a condition code), row (a Cond_Flags row number that picks the bank of a flag field).
#   by-row (the row comes from another field), - (not a flag field).
# A ? marks a column the source does not settle.
